description: This file defines the 'Antispam' controller class for the admin CMS section of the OpenCart project. It includes methods for listing, editing, adding, deleting, and saving antispam keywords, essential for managing anti-spam measures within the admin interface.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Controller class for managing anti-spam keywords in the admin CMS section; includes methods for listing, editing, adding, and saving antispam entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main view showing the list of antispam entries, with filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of antispam entries as a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of antispam entries based on filter, sort, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an antispam entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing antispam entry, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected antispam entries, performing permission check and returning JSON response.
